description: This file contains the implementation of the StaticGatewayListProvider class, which provides a static list of gateway URIs for Orleans clusters based on configured options. It implements the IGatewayListProvider interface and is used within the Orleans messaging infrastructure.

classes.name: StaticGatewayListProvider
classes.description: Implements IGatewayListProvider, providing a static list of gateways based on configuration options.

methods.name: StaticGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider with options for gateways and gateway refresh period.

methods.name: InitializeGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Method to initialize the gateway list provider, currently a no-op with a completed task.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Returns the configured list of gateway URIs asynchronously.
